DuelRecord.title: DuelRecord
DuelRecord.description: A recorded simultaneous 2-family duel in Le défi des Mudras with per-level challenge verdicts and Tortue d'Or reward outcomes.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the event host who recorded this duel.

duelNumber.description: Sequential duel number within the host's register.

recordedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string displayed in the host's duel log.

familyAOutcome.description: Final Tortue d'Or reward outcome for Family 1.

familyALevelResults.description: Fixed 7-element array (6 for legacy duels) of per-level challenge verdicts for Family 1 (pending, passed, failed).

familyAMudrasReached.description: Number of mudras reached by Family 1 (-1 when unset, otherwise 0..11).

familyAElapsedSec.description: Elapsed duel seconds for Family 1 (-1 when unset, otherwise 0..86400).

familyBOutcome.description: Final Tortue d'Or reward outcome for Family 2.

familyBLevelResults.description: Fixed 7-element array (6 for legacy duels) of per-level challenge verdicts for Family 2 (pending, passed, failed).

familyBMudrasReached.description: Number of mudras reached by Family 2 (-1 when unset, otherwise 0..11).

familyBElapsedSec.description: Elapsed duel seconds for Family 2 (-1 when unset, otherwise 0..86400).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the duel was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the duel was last modified.

/duels/{duelId}.description: Host-owned recorded family duels for Le défi des Mudras.
